This beta update fixes the jump-jet recharge workaround, replicates the
original game's component-damage-based lighting, fixes HUD meter rendering,
and adds a lower-end 30 FPS launch profile for *MechWarrior 2: 31st Century
Combat* DOS v1.1.

**Supported platform:** Windows x64 on Intel or AMD 64-bit hardware. Linux,
Wine, and Windows ARM64 are not supported.

## Changes since v0.9.0

- Corrected the jump-jet recharge fix to resolve the current player mech and
  write its actual 32-bit fuel field. The previous release could write to the
  wrong game-memory location in some missions.
- Added `launchmw2_30fps.bat`, the lower-end profile previously distributed as
  a separate v0.9.0 patch.
- Improved mech and object lighting, including ambient light, component-damage
  brightening, camouflage, emblems, helicopter rotors, and aeroplane lift fans.
- Improved HUD meter placement and shading at scaled output resolutions.
- Reset relative HOTAS turret aim when a new mission starts.

## Installing

- Download `mw2-enhanced-renderer-mod-v0.9.1-windows-x64.zip` and extract it.
- Run `configure.bat`.
- Open **Game Installation** and follow the instructions there. When your own
  game files are in the correct location and match the supported DOS v1.1
  release, the configurator displays a green
  **✓ Supported files verified** result.

If you have difficulty running `configure.bat`, follow the **Installing**
section in the included README instead.

## Updating from an earlier installation

To carry settings forward from an earlier installation, copy
`mw2mods/mod.conf` from the old installation into the new one. If you configured
HOTAS axes, copy `mw2mods/joystick.conf` as well. These are the files where the
configurator stores its settings.

## Beta limitations

- Full render distance may interfere with or reveal parts of some missions
  earlier than intended.
- Frame rates above the supplied 72 FPS profile can break LRM missiles.
- Pressing `Esc` during a mission can occasionally terminate it with a
  `divide overflow` error.
- Mission resource preloading may cause cache pressure in some missions or
  long loading times on certain systems. If this happens, run `configure.bat`,
  set **Advanced → Disable texture preload** to **true**, and launch the game
  with `launchmw2_sbs_compare.bat`. This starts the enhanced and original
  renderers side by side.
- A few terrain seams and smaller rendering differences remain.

Reports of major reproducible issues are appreciated. This is beta-quality
software, provided as-is, so please keep your original game installation and
saves backed up.
